coaching.headline: We traded the base for camps: nine of their thirteen structures fell while we were taking a Fangtooth, Prime or Genesis Core.
coaching.team: We lost a 46-20 game to minion waves. Their players did 33,043 objective damage all game, less than Murdock's 65,804 alone, and still took thirteen structures to our six, because nine of those thirteen fell while we were killing a Fangtooth, a Prime or a Genesis Core somewhere else, and seven fell with nobody on our side dead. It ended the game in the last minute: the sixth inhibitor at 45.1 and the core at 45.4 while we were winning the fight at Orb Prime 4-1. Ten major objectives, none of them the one that ends a game.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The ace at 41.5. All five of theirs dead, two inner towers and an inhibitor taken by minute 43, and the team went to Primal Fangtooth at 43 instead of the core.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane: first blood, first Fangtooth, and zero duo deaths before 10 minutes against their two.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett's offlane read even early, theirs late. The survival line was the right one: 4 deaths all game, one of them a solo catch at 5.2 by Serath, on a team-high 86,182 mitigated. The gap was objective damage, 10,346, lowest on the roster. 37.4.call: Lt. Belica's solo catch at 36.9 made this a 4v5 before it started; winning it 2-0 anyway did not save the inhibitor, which fell at 37.8 with the team going to Orb Prime next.

45.2.call: The wrong place. Their sixth inhibitor fell at 45.1 and the core at 45.4 while we won 4-1 at Orb Prime. Four bodies at the core holds the game.

focus.title: The base is the objective
focus.evidence: Seven of their thirteen structures fell with nobody on our side dead, five of them while we were winning the fight next to that structure. The fix is one player on the wave while four finish the fight.
focus.action: Call it before the fight: name the structure we walk to if we win it, and name who stays on the wave.

deepDive.verdict: We fought for ten major objectives and let minion waves take the base: thirteen structures to six, nine of them lost while we were on a camp.

causes.claim: Seven of the ten camps we took were paid for with a structure, and we accepted that trade nine times.
causes.receipt: Fangtooth at 11.7 cost the outer tower at 12. Genesis Core at 31 cost our last inner tower at 31.9 and the inhibitor right after it. Primal Fangtooth at 33.2 cost the inhibitor at 34.6. Genesis Core at 40.7 cost the inhibitor at 41.8.

causes.claim: Their sieging was waves, not players, so winning fights never stopped it.
causes.receipt: Their players did 33,043 objective damage all game and took thirteen structures. Seven fell with nobody on our side dead. Five of those fell while we were winning the fight at that structure. Inner towers: 25.6 and 31.9. Inhibitors: 32.1, 34.6 and 41.8.

causes.claim: The game-ending minute was spent at Orb Prime while the core fell.
causes.receipt: Their sixth inhibitor kill came at 45.1 and the core at 45.4. The fight at Orb Prime at 45.2 was won 4-1 with Aurora the only death, and Orb Prime was taken at 45.2.

causes.claim: The fight that set the pattern: five at our inner tower while Fangtooth went down, lost with an item lead.
causes.receipt: At 19.6 we had 10 items online to their 7 and lost the fight 3-5. Fangtooth fell to us at 19.8 mid-fight, and Scarlett, Murdock and Phase were dead when the inner tower fell at 20.

causes.claim: Won fights were spent on camps while the base kept falling.
causes.receipt: Nine fights won, five cashed: four of the five into a Fangtooth, Prime or Genesis Core. Only the ace at 41.5 turned into structures, and that stopped after two inner towers and an inhibitor by minute 43. The wins at 21.4, 34.8 and 39 bought nothing. The fight at 45.2, won 4-1, bought Orb Prime while the core fell at 45.4.

deepDive.ledger: 12: outer tower, for the Fangtooth at 11.7. 16.4: outer tower, nobody dead, no fight. 17.8: outer tower after the fight at 17.5, lost 1-2. 20: inner tower, fight lost 3-5 while Fangtooth went down at 19.8. 25.6: inner tower, nobody dead, the fight at 25.7 won 2-1. 29.4: first inhibitor, Aurora dead, then their Orb Prime at 30.3. 31.9 and 32.1: our last inner tower and the second inhibitor, nobody dead, Genesis Core at 31. 34.6: third inhibitor, nobody dead, Primal Fangtooth at 33.2. 37.8: fourth inhibitor, Lt. Belica caught alone at 36.9. 41.8: fifth inhibitor, nobody dead, Genesis Core at 40.7, then the ace at 41.5. 45.1 and 45.4: sixth inhibitor and the core, Aurora dead, the fight at Orb Prime won 4-1.
deepDive.theCall: At 42 all five of theirs were dead off the ace at 41.5, won 5-0, and we took two inner towers and an inhibitor by minute 43. The next structure was the core. Instead the team went to Primal Fangtooth at 43, they respawned, and the game ran three more minutes we did not have.
deepDive.rule: After an ace past minute 35, the next objective is the core, never a camp.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up
